newsitem.title: CANADA: TransCanada PipeLines to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: TransCanada PipeLines to redeem debentures.

text.p: TransCanada PipeLines Ltd said on Monday it notified Alberta that it would redeem the C$150 million, 10.426 percent convertible debentures held by the province on December 6.
Under terms of an agreement between TransCanada and the Alberta announced on November 13, the province would immediately sell the shares in Canada.

The number of shares to be sold would be determined by a requirement that the sale results in net proceeds equal to the principal amount of the redeemed debentures, TCPL said. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
